admission.justification: Spans repeated requests: reusing recorded choices and call, setting mode fields before agent creation, and keeping observations distinct from requested values is how FAM-N17BB4 stays repeatable across retries.

applicability: Every repeated (replayed or relaunched) role request and its recorded call.
conditions: Initial mode fields are set before agent creation.
Mode observations are compared against requested values, not merged with them.
exclusions: Old request digests, which an empty feature map must not break.
statement: A repeated request uses its recorded choices and call; initial mode fields are set before agent creation, mode observations remain distinguishable from requested values, and empty feature maps do not break old request digests.
